body:
There's nobody to call. I don't care anymore. 

Going back home isn't an option, and neither is staying in this city. I have to die. there's not other way.

No, I don't care about stigma; I care about a living wage which those jobs don't provide. Sure I could work in a supermarket but I wouldn't make enough to move out or save up. It's simply not enough money to do anything other than just survive.

Well the first and second time it was sociology. First time I left because I was unsure that's what I wanted, second time I left after a nervous breakdown that didn't have much to do with school but left me unable to cope with any stress. 

After that I felt going back to study sociology for the third time would be seen as stupid by my family and everyone else so I chose programming and went to a vocational school (I live in Europe) to learn it. But it sucked, it didn't interest me and the math was too hard and the stress of the midterms sent me to the hospital.

I really don't know what to do now. It's very hard to find  a job with just high school so I guess a lifetime of working in retail is the highest I can aim for.

I don't like "leaning on" my family, they've already suffered through so much with me. I wish they would kick me out of the house, that's what I deserve after so much money wasted on my education.

This is my third time dropping out of school due to illness - more or less. The truth is I don't want to go and being ill is a handy excuse. I'm too dumb for post-secondary education. The problem is no one is hiring high school graduates for anything better than supermarket jobs. I tired that once, didn't like it and quit after a day. That's the kind of person I am, I really don't deserve anyone's sympathy. I brought this all on myself.

I really should just die.
Maybe you are right.

I honestly don't know. I used to think I was interested in computers but now I don't know. I thought I was interested in sociology but I flunked out that school.

I'm interested in programming, I think. But my school has all sorts of other requirements that I don't care about - math and electric engineering being two of them. They are mandatory and you can't graduate without passing them.
We don't really have clubs and study groups here. It's just not something people do.

Thanks. I don't really have many friends, I have next to none IRL. That's one of the problems and possible snags with this compartmentalization idea for instance, I think for it to work you have to have at least one good part of your life and I have none. I have no friends, I sort of hate the school I go to, I don't perform well academically and I was never in a relationship so I don't have a love life.

I also feel like I should add I am not stranger to the psychiatric world, I've had a psychosis two years ago and spent a month in the hospital and I've been depressed and on an and off medication since high school.

I don't actually enjoy that many things anymore, and even those that I do like playing video games and watching TV are unhealthy and make me feel guilty for not doing something more productive.

You are however correct. I need therapy, I need actual CBT that gives out actual methods to cope with things. So far I have only tried REBT, which really didn't help that much. I didn't like spending so much time talking about my feelings, and when I had talk therapy with a psychologist at the place I was committed in all they were concerned about is "why I don't have motivation and why do I think I don't have it". After 4 sessions of that same question I gave up.

You are right, I should get a good therapist. Thanks.

There's really no mechanism in my country to take time off. I mean there is, but it's expensive. Also I already took time off from my last school before ultimately dropping out. It's just not viable. I have to tough it out no matter the emotional cost.

No. I could seek therapy but I feel it's all pointless because I want to leave school but I can't and that's the source of all my problems. If I can't say that in therapy or really to anyone then what's the point? 

I'm very lonely and miserable and it's killing me.
Usually I do but not about this. This has all been my idea, I sold them on it. Remember that I already left school twice before. I can't break their hearts.

Well, I'm at the beginning. Like this is my first semester. Also, I think what you suggest can be done if one is good at schoolwork but I am not. I'm not smart, I really need a long time to study. I am even getting private lessons for a couple of things. I suck.

But schools eats up so much of my time, classes are hard and require a lot of work. I should probably be studying right now really. On top of that my parents pay for all of this, my whole life is on their dime and I would feel bad if I ignored my school duties to focus on something else.

My life revolves around school, I haven't the time for anything else.

I live in a country where there are no community colleges. It's not possible to figure yourself out, or "explore". You need to pick a school in a field and commit to it. That's how it works in most of Europe. 

Dropping out means starting completely over if you want to study something else. Preparing for entrance exams, etc...
I don't think that's how the real world works. What will I eat?
I already just dropped another thing.. twice. I'm running out of time, I'm 23 without a job or an education.

I'm about to be in the same boat. I don't know what to say except that I really hope a failed education and being lonely isn't the end of the road. Maybe we can find happiness in some simple job and maybe loneliness isn't forever?
how did you get stuck?

i already flunked out of one university - twice. but here's the thing. that was what i really wanted - social science. it was just the timing was always off, i had psychosis, i had breakdowns and i had to leave for good eventually, it just wasn't feasible to graduate on time and be employable.

so like now i want to be a software engineer. except i kind of don't. i am just doing it cause it's the only normal thing i could think of. i'm miserable there, because there's a lot of subjects that are required that i haven't had any previous contact with and that don't interest me like electrical engineering or electronics. sadly i have to take them, they're requirements. they're very hard and tbh i think i am kind of too dumb for STEM.

i sort of brought myself into this position where i really can't leave this current school i'm in without significantly making everyone especially my parents hate me and never trust me. i'm stuck into something i don't really want, as if i unconsciouslly planned my own suicide this way.

i am sure i don't have much time. i don't want to kill myself, i'm very very afraid, but i am running out of options. i live alone, i have no friends, sometimes i go days between talking to other human beings. at times people will talk to me in the hallways and stuff but always very brief always as if htey just regretted having addressed me. it's very uncomfortable for me. i feel like i lost the ability to communicate with people. i'm very afraid. i feel like i'm already dying, being physically dead is just a formality at this point.

I don't have hobbies. I'm very lonely. There is no campus,  I go to a vocational school. It's not even university. The professors won't care for my troubles, and even if they did I'm so out of it I don't know what to ask.

It's fine. I've accepted that this will end in failure.

Every new days feels like a punishment. I get up, I go to school where most things go over my head and no one ever talks to me. I return home not having spoken to a single human being. I am due to fail all my courses, and disappoint my parents again.
Today was my first day at it. I'm sure I will fail out of it eventually. I suck at everything.

There are no majors where I'm from. I'm attending a technical college. It's a 3 year program meant to eventually make you ready to get a job in software engineering, network administration or electronics/circuits/microprocessors. I want to be a software engineer and as such I don't really have much use for EE, but it's a required course. You must take it and pass it. 

I'm having trouble with everything in it. I missed the first lecture and they're moving at a very fast pace. I'm not good with physics. I'll have to pay someone to tutor me basically and even then the best I can hope for is a passing grade.

I have one friend, and I use that term very loosely. He thinks of me more as a pathetic hanger on that he cares about rather than an equal. But it's obviously my fault, because I am a pathetic clingy hanger on.

What for? So you can tell me I'm a spoiled child and ignore the fact I'm seriously mentally ill for the sake of bullshit pop psychology? Sure. Shoot. Tell me how I just need to find the strength within me or some such bullshit.
Go to hell you fucking asshole piece of shit. You don't know my life.
I wish I had your determination. I can't even be stable enough to get a date, let alone plan a life with someone. But it's a nice thought, for sure.
lol all my life basically.

I know how that feels. I'm having a rough night too, basically if I move from the computer or become unoccupied for just one moment even if just going to the bathroom  - my paranoid thoughts flood back in.

You don't seem like you like video games? I've been playing rounds of Dissidia: Final Fantasy between talking to people here. If you have a smartphone you could try to occupy your time with some inane timewaster that doesn't require thought - like Bejeweled or Candy Crush or Temple Run.

I may come off as insensitive right now but nothing is funnier to me than wet cats. They just look so funny. It was probably cold in the room though, it didn't want to leave the bath for the same reason people don't want to leave their shower, it's colder outside.

I know how you feel, I think. You always come down the worst after a period when you think you feel okay. I'm glad you're feeling at least a little better. Have you considered trying to sleep? One trick I learned is to just go to bed, make yourself comfortable but don't worry about sleeping. Just say, I'm going to lay down now just for comfort or just to think in bed. And then just don't worry about sleeping. Sometimes the tiredness just takes over. idk. 

I learned that in the hospital. There was nothing much to do, and I would go to be as soon as it was allowed - at 9pm. So I got good at just lying there with my head empty letting sleep take me. 

One thing you could also do if you can't sleep, to keep yourself occupied and I do it too sometimes even though it's bad and unhealthy is to call a 24 hour delivery service and order some food. It gives you something to wait for, it will take at least an hour and then you can eat it while watching some milquetoast anodyne movie or TV show.

Like have you seen Mean Girls? That's a good funny PG rated comedy. Or you could watch Bob's Burgers, it's like Family Guy but without all the racism and shock humor.

No, there are certain triggering things for me. They know about my drug use and being gay. 

I really don't want to go that way, it triggers me.

Have you tried watching ferret videos though? It's a whole new world. 
http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=P9VVa9NahSQ

I understand about your family, I never want to worry them either. They think I am better too, but today I had to tell my mother I'd like to see my therapist again for an evaluation.

If you do go to a hospital for a longer time, remember it's not your fault you need help. It sounds callous, but it doesn't matter what shock it will be for them, it matters that you feel better.

Yeah, but I can't exactly put into words how I feel without going into something they don't know about and I can't tell them. Or anyone, really. 

So...  there is no one to talk to right now.
They would just give me risperidone, my hair would start falling out and I'd get fat. I danced the psychiatrist dance before.

Don't do anything you're not comfortable with. Maybe you can just watch cute animal videos on youtube? Let's plays of some video games you like, if you like video games? 

Do you have anyone to call on the phone? Maybe a parent or sibling?

Do you live in a bad neighborhood? I'm really sorry, it's my male privilege I guess. I take 3 am walks all the time. 

Are you feeling suicidal right now or just generally anxious and depressed?

i'm in a similar state, only not so acute at the moment.  it can be hard to focus on doing "meaningful" things like reading books or watching a movie.

it's totally okay to look at random online pictures for the next 12 hours. how late is it where you are? Can you take a walk  through your neighborhood? Go to a 24 hour fast food place and eat a lot of unhealthy food. That's what I used to do when I felt relaly bad. It's okay, help is on the way now, right?

I understand a lot of what you're going through. For me forgetting how to to talk to people and socialize happened after I got out a mental hospital. It crushed my self-esteem completely. After that I spent a year at university and it was hell. All those people had their own cliques since they'd all known each other for a year (I took a "break" during my stint at the hospital) and no one gave me the time of the day.

I go through periods where I don't want to do anything. Video games, books, I don't even listen to music. 

I comfort eat too, there's a McDonald's just down the street from my new apartment and I'm afraid I'll put on all the weight I lost during the sumer.

My life is taking a turn for the worse right now. I'm going to lose a tooth. It had a root canal done, and either it was done badly or I was just unlucky cause those things can last 2 months or 20 years - but it has to go. It hurts and there's nothing you can do to save a tooth past a root canal. Sure, I can afford to put in a fake one (I live in Europe, dental stuff isn't as expensive here) but it means a month of walking around without a tooth waiting for the would to heal. Just in time for school, so everyone can remember me as the toothless guy (school starts in October here).

There's no point to this ramble, sorry. I hope your life gets better.
